title: 嘉靖二十二年河南鄉試錄
text:
河南鄉試錄序
夫河南天地之中在昔王者
所更居也故聞人茂士代有
其　恒曰中土多才云
今上卽位　十二年歲當嘉靖
癸卯會鄉試之期　咸巡按
御史楊〔勉學〕被
===
命來按茲土寔監臨之中布令規
祗敬必飭先期聘〔節〕等典司
考試比至校易則教授李〔應〕
〔霑〕教諭曲〔履繩〕校書則教諭
張〔偉〕魏〔濠〕校詩則教諭李〔鼎〕
陳〔繼文〕春秋則教諭劉〔寵〕禮
記則學正楊〔道南〕而〔節〕與教
punctuated:
河南鄉試錄序

夫河南，天地之中，在昔王者所更居也。故聞人茂士，代有其，恒曰：「中土多才」云。

今上卽位十二年，歲當嘉靖癸卯，會鄉試之期，咸巡按御史楊〔勉學〕被命來按茲土，寔監臨之中，布令規，祗敬必飭。先期聘〔節〕等典司考試。比至，校《易》則教授李〔應〕〔霑〕、教諭曲〔履繩〕；校《書》則教諭張〔偉〕、魏〔濠〕；校《詩》則教諭李〔鼎〕、陳〔繼文〕；《春秋》則教諭劉〔寵〕；《禮記》則學正楊〔道南〕。而〔節〕與教
translation_en:
Preface to the Record of the Henan Provincial Examination

Henan lies at the center of Heaven and Earth and was where the kings of antiquity successively established their residences. Thus, renowned men and outstanding scholars have appeared there in every generation [?], and it has long been said: “The central lands abound in talent.”

In the twelfth year [?] after the present emperor ascended the throne, the guimao year of the Jiajing reign, when the Provincial Examination was due, the Regional Inspector, Yang Mianxue, received orders to inspect this territory [the preceding character 咸 is unclear]. He served as Supervising Official [?], promulgating rules and requiring reverent diligence and strict observance. Before the appointed time, he invited me, Jie, and others to administer the examination. Upon our arrival, the examiners for the Book of Changes were Li Yingzhan, Prefectural School Instructor, and Qu Lüsheng, County School Instructor; for the Book of Documents, Zhang Wei and Wei Hao, County School Instructors; for the Book of Odes, Li Ding and Chen Jiwen, County School Instructors; for the Spring and Autumn Annals, Liu Chong, County School Instructor; and for the Book of Rites, Yang Daonan, Departmental School Instructor. And I, Jie, together with the County School Instructor …

title: 嘉靖二十二年河南鄉試錄
text:
諭莫〔佯〕謬總校事於是以左
叅政馮〔亮〕右叅政李〔充濶〕爲
提調以按察使雒〔昂〕副使李
〔仁〕爲監試下訖諸執事悉簡
賢而任之蓋重求賢之
盛典而思得眞才以獻之
當宁之上者也汝多士其念哉自
===
夫河洛發祥匵祉圖書並出
示象之文著而含章之義宣
文不在玆乎
國家以文取士蓋因文以見士
而士則以文自見苟不本於
心則奏末技託空言有道者
之明忌而深黜焉者也亦奚
punctuated:
諭莫〔佯〕謬總校事。於是，以左叅政馮〔亮〕、右叅政李〔充濶〕爲提調，以按察使雒〔昂〕、副使李〔仁〕爲監試，下訖諸執事，悉簡賢而任之。蓋重求賢之盛典，而思得眞才以獻之當宁之上者也。汝多士其念哉！
自夫河洛發祥匵祉，圖書並出，示象之文著，而含章之義宣，文不在玆乎？國家以文取士，蓋因文以見士，而士則以文自見。苟不本於心，則奏末技、託空言，有道者之明忌而深黜焉者也。亦奚
translation_en:
…Instructor Mo Yang 莫佯 [?] undertook, unworthily, overall responsibility for evaluating the examination papers. Thereupon, Feng Liang 馮亮, Left Administration Vice Commissioner, and Li Chongkuo 李充濶, Right Administration Vice Commissioner, were appointed Proctors; Luo Ang 雒昂, Surveillance Commissioner, and Li Ren 李仁, Surveillance Vice Commissioner, were appointed examination monitors. Down to all the functionaries, worthy men were selected and entrusted with their duties. This was done out of respect for the great ceremony of seeking worthy men, and from the desire to obtain genuine talent to present to His Majesty upon the throne. You assembled scholars should keep this in mind!
Ever since the Yellow River and the Luo River manifested auspicious signs and blessings [?], and the River Chart and Luo Writing both appeared, the patterns displaying images became manifest, and the meaning of holding cultivated excellence within was revealed. Does not cultural refinement reside here? The state selects scholars through their writing: through writing it discerns the men, while the men make themselves known through writing. If writing is not rooted in the heart, it merely displays trivial skills and relies on empty words—things that those who possess the Way expressly abhor and firmly reject. What, then, would …

title: 嘉靖二十二年河南鄉試錄
text:
取於文哉君子之學學諸心
而已矣道德積於中而文自
著見於其外故文者道之顯
德之華也古之人湛道德浮
英華發而爲文措之爲大業
孔子所稱躬行君子者邪奈
何綴文之士絺句繪章炳若
===
縟繡外雖雕琢曼辭以自飾
夷考其中則泯然無足稱者
而猶自列於君子之林適足
以自點耳此所謂漸漬於失
教而被服於成習者乎
明興百有七十餘年道化汪濊漸
被宇内至弘治間文體渾厚
punctuated:
取於文哉？君子之學，學諸心而已矣。道德積於中，而文自著見於其外。故文者，道之顯、德之華也。古之人湛道德，浮英華，發而爲文，措之爲大業，孔子所稱躬行君子者邪？奈何綴文之士，絺句繪章，炳若縟繡，外雖雕琢曼辭以自飾，夷考其中，則泯然無足稱者，而猶自列於君子之林，適足以自點耳。此所謂漸漬於失教而被服於成習者乎？
明興百有七十餘年，道化汪濊，漸被宇内。至弘治間，文體渾厚。
translation_en:
…what, then, would be worth seeking in literary composition? The learning of the gentleman is simply learning within the heart. When the Way and virtue accumulate within, literary expression naturally manifests itself outwardly. Thus, writing is the manifestation of the Way and the flowering of virtue. The ancients immersed themselves in the Way and virtue, letting their finest qualities rise to the surface; expressed in words, these became writing, and put into practice, they became great achievements. Were these not those whom Confucius called gentlemen who put their principles into practice? How is it that men who compose writings embroider their phrases and paint their passages, making them gleam like rich brocade? Though outwardly they adorn themselves with elaborately wrought, graceful language, a dispassionate examination of what lies within reveals nothing worthy of praise. Yet they still rank themselves among gentlemen, thereby succeeding only in sullying themselves. Are these what are called men steeped in the failings of instruction and clothed in ingrained habits?
More than one hundred and seventy years have passed since the rise of the Ming. The transforming influence of the Way has spread abundantly, gradually reaching all within the realm. By the Hongzhi reign, literary style was substantial and profound…

title: 嘉靖二十二年河南鄉試錄
text:
宏博爾雅莊正一時公卿大
夫士吏斌斌多文學之士斯
其盛矣正德以來文極盛而
詞益工旨愈之而彌遠思按
之而逾深視昔少異焉迨我
皇上紹三五之統
昭至德配天地崇化厲賢勸學
===
制禮
宸章聖藻煥乎有文天下之學士
靡然鄉風矣士之生斯時者
身被
聖人之化而親覩
中興之盛豈非幸哉余聞之夏
之靡商之伊陟傅說周之申
punctuated:
宏博爾雅莊正，一時公卿大夫士吏，斌斌多文學之士，斯其盛矣。正德以來，文極盛而詞益工，旨愈之而彌遠，思按之而逾深，視昔少異焉。迨我皇上紹三五之統，昭至德配天地，崇化厲賢，勸學制禮，宸章聖藻，煥乎有文，天下之學士靡然鄉風矣。士之生斯時者，身被聖人之化，而親覩中興之盛，豈非幸哉！

余聞之，夏之靡，商之伊陟、傅說，周之申
translation_en:
…broad in scope, refined, dignified, and upright. Among the high ministers, grandees, scholars, and functionaries of that time were many men of literary learning and cultivated bearing. This was indeed a flourishing age. Since the Zhengde reign, literary composition has reached its height, and diction has grown ever more accomplished; its purport has become ever more far-reaching [?], and its thought, upon examination, ever more profound, differing somewhat from that of earlier times. When our Emperor succeeded to the line of the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors, he manifested supreme virtue matching Heaven and Earth, promoted moral transformation and encouraged the worthy, fostered learning and established rites. His imperial compositions and sage writings shone with literary brilliance, and scholars throughout the realm inclined toward his example. Is it not fortunate for scholars born in this age to receive personally the transforming influence of a sage and witness for themselves the splendor of a dynastic resurgence?

I have heard of Mi of the Xia, Yi Zhi and Fu Yue of the Shang, and Shen… of the Zhou.

title: 嘉靖二十二年河南鄉試錄
text:
伯甫侯仲山甫皆茲土之產
中興之名輔也其在當時翊
運庇民各相其主成一代穆
清之烈而文采表後世布在
方策今皆可得而稽云汝多
士生同其地而復際此
貞期行將脫巾筮仕誠能錯事
以進結於
展采奮庸熙載效欸欸之忠
===
明主以輔
今日中興之治與數君子者比跡
後先斯舉也亦將與有榮耀
矣乎否則據傲乘邪以求一
日之富貴重爲天下觀笑余
punctuated: 伯、甫侯、仲山甫，皆茲土之產，中興之名輔也。其在當時，翊運庇民，各相其主，成一代穆清之烈，而文采表後世，布在方策，今皆可得而稽云。汝多士，生同其地，而復際此貞期，行將脫巾筮仕。誠能錯事以進，結於展采奮庸，熙載效欸欸之忠，明主以輔今日中興之治，與數君子者比跡後先，斯舉也，亦將與有榮耀矣乎！否則，據傲乘邪，以求一日之富貴，重爲天下觀笑，余……
translation_en:
…Bo, the Marquis of Fu, and Zhong Shanfu were all natives of this land and renowned ministers who assisted dynastic restorations. In their own times, they upheld the fortunes of the dynasty and protected the people, each assisting his ruler in achieving an era of harmonious and enlightened government. Their cultural brilliance stood as an example to later generations; their deeds are recorded in books and can all still be examined today.

You scholars were born in the same land and have again encountered such an auspicious age. You will soon put aside your scholars’ headcloths and embark upon official careers. If you can truly advance through attending to affairs, win the enlightened ruler’s confidence, display your talents and exert your abilities, bring distinction to your duties, and offer your most earnest loyalty [?], thereby assisting today’s restored government and following in the footsteps of those gentlemen, will not this examination, too, share in your glory? Otherwise, if you conduct yourselves arrogantly and resort to crooked means in pursuit of fleeting wealth and rank, becoming once again a spectacle of ridicule for all under Heaven, I…

title: 嘉靖二十二年河南鄉試錄
text:
甚懼焉汝多士其念哉是時
巡撫右僉都御史李〔宗樞〕作
率庶士文教以興總督軍務
右侍郎翟〔鵬〕奠綏障徼內地
晏然而士皆安業總理河道
尚書周〔用〕撫治鄖陽右僉都
御史王〔守〕監察御史巡鹽裴
===
紳曹〔邦輔〕印馬項〔廷吉〕夙重
文學崇尚賓興署員外郎劉
來行人張〔玶〕溫新奉使於茲
欒觀厥成左布政使孫〔存〕右
叅政蕭〔一中〕左叅議龔〔良傅〕
張〔舜元〕右叅議王〔崇〕副使喬
瑞柴〔儒〕黃〔潤〕吳〔惺〕僉事翟〔鎬〕
punctuated: 甚懼焉。汝多士其念哉！是時，巡撫右僉都御史李〔宗樞〕作率庶士，文教以興；總督軍務右侍郎翟〔鵬〕奠綏障徼，內地晏然，而士皆安業；總理河道尚書周〔用〕、撫治鄖陽右僉都御史王〔守〕、監察御史巡鹽裴紳、曹〔邦輔〕，印馬項〔廷吉〕，夙重文學，崇尚賓興。署員外郎劉來、行人張〔玶〕、溫新，奉使於茲，欒觀厥成。左布政使孫〔存〕、右叅政蕭〔一中〕、左叅議龔〔良傅〕、張〔舜元〕、右叅議王〔崇〕、副使喬瑞、柴〔儒〕、黃〔潤〕、吳〔惺〕、僉事翟〔鎬〕、
translation_en:
…I greatly fear this. You assembled scholars should keep it in mind!

At this time, Li Zongshu, Grand Coordinator and Assistant Censor-in-chief of the Right, set an example for the scholars, and literary education flourished. Zhai Peng, Supreme Commander of Military Affairs and Vice Minister of the Right, secured and pacified the frontier defenses; the interior was tranquil, and the scholars could all pursue their studies in peace. Zhou Yong, Minister and Director-general of River Conservancy; Wang Shou, Pacification Commissioner of Yunyang and Assistant Censor-in-chief of the Right; Pei Shen and Cao Bangfu, Investigating Censors inspecting the salt administration; and Xiang Tingji, Investigating Censor supervising horse branding, had long esteemed literary learning and promoted the selection and presentation of worthy scholars. Liu Lai, Acting Vice Director, and Zhang Ping and Wen Xin, Messengers, came here on official missions and witnessed its successful completion [the wording 欒觀 is doubtful].

Sun Cun was Provincial Administration Commissioner of the Left. Xiao Yizhong was Provincial Administration Vice Commissioner of the Right. Gong Liangfu and Zhang Shunyuan were Provincial Administration Assistant Commissioners of the Left. Wang Chong was Provincial Administration Assistant Commissioner of the Right. Qiao Rui, Chai Ru, Huang Run, and Wu Xing were Surveillance Vice Commissioners. Zhai Gao was a Surveillance Assistant Commissioner …

title: 嘉靖二十二年河南鄉試錄
text:
劉〔澍〕呂〔懷健〕佘〔承業〕顧〔琳〕王
〔三聘〕都指揮僉事沈〔一元〕景
〔紹宗〕王〔執敬〕則皆先後贊襄
協厥事焉茲試也提學副使
葛〔守禮〕選士一千八百七十
五人遵
制三試之中式者八十人錄文凡
二十篇
湖廣荊州府江陵縣儒學教
諭張〔節〕謹序
punctuated:
劉〔澍〕、呂〔懷健〕、佘〔承業〕、顧〔琳〕、王〔三聘〕，都指揮僉事沈〔一元〕、景〔紹宗〕、王〔執敬〕，則皆先後贊襄，協厥事焉。茲試也，提學副使葛〔守禮〕選士一千八百七十五人，遵制三試之，中式者八十人，錄文凡二十篇。
湖廣荊州府江陵縣儒學教諭張〔節〕謹序。
translation_en:
…Liu Shu, Lü Huaijian, She Chengye, Gu Lin, and Wang Sanpin; and Assistant Regional Military Commissioners Shen Yiyuan, Jing Shaozong, and Wang Zhijing—all in turn lent their assistance and cooperated in conducting this undertaking. For this examination, Ge Shouli, Deputy Surveillance Commissioner in charge of education, selected 1,875 candidates. In accordance with imperial regulations, they were examined in three sessions; eighty passed. Twenty essays in all are included in this record.
Respectfully composed as a preface by Zhang Jie, Instructor of the Confucian School of Jiangling County, Jingzhou Prefecture, Huguang.

title: 嘉靖二十二年河南鄉試錄
text:
嘉靖二十二年河南鄉試
監臨官
巡按河南監察御史楊勉學〔仲潛山東茌平縣人　壬辰進士〕
提調官
河南等處承宣布政使司左叅政馮亮〔執夫浙江金華縣人　壬辰進士〕
河南等處承宣布政使司右叅政李充濁〔澄之直隷永平衛官　籍盧龍縣丙戌進士〕
監試官
河南等處提刑按察司按察使雒昂〔仲俛陝西三原縣人　癸未進士〕
河南等處提刑按察司副使李仁〔元夫山東東阿縣人　癸未進士〕
===
考試官
湖廣荆州府江陵縣儒學教諭張節〔亨甫廣西臨桂縣人　辛卯貢士〕
陝西漢中府金州平利縣儒學教諭莫倖〔仲齊貴州青平衛官籍　直隷江都縣丁酉貢士〕
直隷順德府儒學教授李應露〔伯雨陝西三原縣人　癸酉貢士〕
同考試官
直隷廬州府無爲州儒學學正楊道南〔載吾福建懷安縣人　辛卯貢士〕
直隷常州府宜興縣儒學教諭張偉〔子成江西貴溪縣人　辛卯貢士〕
浙江湖州府武康縣儒學教諭魏濠〔方舟福建福清縣人　甲午貢士〕
直隷蘇州府吳江縣儒學教諭劉寵〔承之江西鄱陽縣人　戊子貢士〕
punctuated:
嘉靖二十二年河南鄉試

監臨官
巡按河南監察御史楊勉學〔仲潛，山東茌平縣人，壬辰進士〕。

提調官
河南等處承宣布政使司左叅政馮亮〔執夫，浙江金華縣人，壬辰進士〕。
河南等處承宣布政使司右叅政李充濁〔澄之，直隷永平衛官籍，盧龍縣，丙戌進士〕。

監試官
河南等處提刑按察司按察使雒昂〔仲俛，陝西三原縣人，癸未進士〕。
河南等處提刑按察司副使李仁〔元夫，山東東阿縣人，癸未進士〕。

考試官
湖廣荆州府江陵縣儒學教諭張節〔亨甫，廣西臨桂縣人，辛卯貢士〕。
陝西漢中府金州平利縣儒學教諭莫倖〔仲齊，貴州青平衛官籍，直隷江都縣，丁酉貢士〕。
直隷順德府儒學教授李應露〔伯雨，陝西三原縣人，癸酉貢士〕。

同考試官
直隷廬州府無爲州儒學學正楊道南〔載吾，福建懷安縣人，辛卯貢士〕。
直隷常州府宜興縣儒學教諭張偉〔子成，江西貴溪縣人，辛卯貢士〕。
浙江湖州府武康縣儒學教諭魏濠〔方舟，福建福清縣人，甲午貢士〕。
直隷蘇州府吳江縣儒學教諭劉寵〔承之，江西鄱陽縣人，戊子貢士〕。
translation_en:
Henan Provincial Examination, the Twenty-second Year of Jiajing (1543)

Supervising Official
Yang Mianxue, Investigating Censor serving as Regional Inspector of Henan, had the courtesy name Zhongqian and was a native of Chiping County, Shandong. He became a metropolitan graduate (jinshi) in the renchen year.

Proctors
Feng Liang, Left Administration Vice Commissioner of the Henan Provincial Administration Commission, had the courtesy name Zhifu and was a native of Jinhua County, Zhejiang. He became a metropolitan graduate in the renchen year.
Li Chongzhuo, Right Administration Vice Commissioner of the Henan Provincial Administration Commission, had the courtesy name Chengzhi. He was registered in an officer household of Yongping Guard in the directly administered territory and was from Lulong County. He became a metropolitan graduate in the bingxu year.

Examination Supervisors
Luo Ang, Surveillance Commissioner of the Henan Provincial Surveillance Commission, had the courtesy name Zhongmian and was a native of Sanyuan County, Shaanxi. He became a metropolitan graduate in the guiwei year.
Li Ren, Surveillance Vice Commissioner of the Henan Provincial Surveillance Commission, had the courtesy name Yuanfu and was a native of Dong'e County, Shandong. He became a metropolitan graduate in the guiwei year.

Examiners
Zhang Jie, Instructor at the Confucian School of Jiangling County, Jingzhou Prefecture, Huguang, had the courtesy name Hengfu and was a native of Lingui County, Guangxi. He became a tribute student (gongshi) in the xinmao year.

title: 嘉靖二十二年河南鄉試錄
text:
第壹塲
四書
有德者必有言有言者不必有德仁者必
有勇勇者不必有仁
性之德也合內外之道也故時措之宜也
予未得爲孔子徒也予私淑諸人也
易
坤至柔而動也剛至靜而德方
有孚中行告公用圭
===
是以君子將有爲也將有行也問焉而以
言其受命也如嚮无有遠近幽深遂知
來物非天下之至精其孰能與於此
昔者聖人之作易也將以順性命之理
書
旣月乃日覲四岳羣牧
若金用汝作礪若濟巨川用汝作舟楫若
歲大旱用汝作霖雨
亦惟助王宅天命作新民
punctuated:
第壹塲

四書
有德者必有言，有言者不必有德；仁者必有勇，勇者不必有仁。
性之德也，合內外之道也，故時措之宜也。
予未得爲孔子徒也，予私淑諸人也。

易
坤至柔而動也剛，至靜而德方。
有孚，中行，告公用圭。
是以君子將有爲也，將有行也，問焉而以言，其受命也如嚮，无有遠近幽深，遂知來物。非天下之至精，其孰能與於此？
昔者聖人之作易也，將以順性命之理。

書
旣月乃日，覲四岳羣牧。
若金，用汝作礪；若濟巨川，用汝作舟楫；若歲大旱，用汝作霖雨。
亦惟助王宅天命，作新民。
translation_en:
First Session

Four Books
One who possesses virtue will surely have something worthy to say; one who has something to say does not necessarily possess virtue. A humane person will surely possess courage; a courageous person does not necessarily possess humaneness.
It is the virtue of one's nature, the Way that unites the inner and the outer; hence its application is fitting to the occasion.
I was unable to become a disciple of Confucius; I have privately cultivated myself through the teachings transmitted by others.

Book of Changes (Yijing)
Kun is utterly yielding, yet firm in its movement; utterly still, yet square in its virtue.
Possessing sincerity and following the middle course, he reports to the duke using a jade tablet.
Thus, when the gentleman is about to undertake something or set out upon a course of action, he questions it in words. It receives his inquiry and responds like an echo; whether distant or near, hidden or profound, he thereby comes to know what is to come. Were it not the most subtle thing under Heaven, what could attain to this?
When the sages of antiquity made the Changes, they intended thereby to follow the principles of human nature and destiny.

Book of Documents (Shujing)
Having fixed the month and then the day, he received in audience the Four Chiefs of the Mountains and the regional governors.
If I am metal, I shall use you as a whetstone; if I am crossing a great river, I shall use you as a boat and oars; if the year brings a great drought, I shall use you as a soaking rain.
It is also to assist the king in securing Heaven's Mandate and to make the people new.

title: 嘉靖二十二年河南鄉試錄
text:
思其艱以圖其易民乃寧
詩
鳲鳩在桑其子七兮淑人君子其儀一兮
其儀一兮心如結兮
以祈甘雨以介我稷黍以穀我士女
鎬京辟廱自西自東自南自北無思不服
其笠伊糾其鎛斯趙
春秋
紀子伯莒子盟于密〔隱公二年〕
===
春公伐戎夏公至自伐戎　秋公會宋人
齊人伐徐〔僖公二十有六年〕
十有二月狄入衛〔閔公二年〕夏六月邢遷
于夷儀齊師宋師曹師城邢〔僖公元年〕
春王正月城楚丘〔僖公二年〕
晉人執季孫意如以歸〔昭公十有三年〕春
意如至自晉〔昭公十有四年〕
禮記
天子諸侯宗廟之祭春曰礿夏曰禘秋曰
punctuated:
思其艱，以圖其易，民乃寧。

詩
鳲鳩在桑，其子七兮。淑人君子，其儀一兮。其儀一兮，心如結兮。
以祈甘雨，以介我稷黍，以穀我士女。
鎬京辟廱，自西自東，自南自北，無思不服。
其笠伊糾，其鎛斯趙。

春秋
紀子伯、莒子盟于密〔隱公二年〕。
春，公伐戎。夏，公至自伐戎。秋，公會宋人、齊人伐徐〔僖公二十有六年〕。
十有二月，狄入衛〔閔公二年〕。夏，六月，邢遷于夷儀。齊師、宋師、曹師城邢〔僖公元年〕。
春，王正月，城楚丘〔僖公二年〕。
晉人執季孫意如以歸〔昭公十有三年〕。春，意如至自晉〔昭公十有四年〕。

禮記
天子、諸侯宗廟之祭，春曰礿，夏曰禘，秋曰
translation_en:
Consider its difficulties in order to make it easy; then the people will be at peace.

Book of Odes
The cuckoo is in the mulberry tree; its young are seven. The good and noble gentleman is constant in his deportment. Constant in his deportment, his heart is as firmly bound as a knot.
To pray for sweet rain, to aid our millet crops, and to nourish our men and women.
At the royal academy in Haojing, from west and east, from south and north, none failed to submit.
Their bamboo hats are closely woven; their hoes pierce the soil.

Spring and Autumn Annals
Zi Bo of Ji [?] and the Viscount of Ju made a covenant at Mi. 〔Second year of Duke Yin.〕
In spring, the duke attacked the Rong. In summer, the duke returned from attacking the Rong. In autumn, the duke joined men of Song and Qi in attacking Xu. 〔Twenty-sixth year of Duke Xi.〕
In the twelfth month, the Di entered Wei. 〔Second year of Duke Min.〕 In summer, in the sixth month, Xing moved to Yiyi. The armies of Qi, Song, and Cao built walls for Xing. 〔First year of Duke Xi.〕
In spring, in the first month of the royal calendar, walls were built at Chuqiu. 〔Second year of Duke Xi.〕
The men of Jin seized Jisun Yiru and took him back with them. 〔Thirteenth year of Duke Zhao.〕 In spring, Yiru returned from Jin. 〔Fourteenth year of Duke Zhao.〕

Book of Rites
Of the sacrifices in the ancestral temples of the Son of Heaven and the feudal lords, the spring sacrifice is called yue, the summer sacrifice di, and the autumn sacrifice is called…

title: 嘉靖二十二年河南鄉試錄
text:
嘗冬曰烝
是故禮者君之大柄也
是故情見而義立樂終而德尊
仁之爲器重其爲道遠舉者莫能勝也行
者莫能致也取數多者仁也夫勉於仁
者不亦難乎
第貳場
論
聖王作民君師
===
詔誥表〔內科一道〕
擬漢賜天下今年田租之半詔〔文帝二年〕
擬唐以温彥博爲右僕射誥〔貞觀十年〕
擬宋以韓琦范仲淹爲樞密副使謝表〔慶
曆三年〕
判語〔五條〕
漏泄軍情大事
任所置買田宅
禁止師巫邪術
punctuated:
嘗，冬曰烝。
是故禮者，君之大柄也。
是故情見而義立，樂終而德尊。
仁之爲器重，其爲道遠，舉者莫能勝也，行者莫能致也，取數多者仁也。夫勉於仁者，不亦難乎？
第貳場
論
聖王作民君師。
詔誥表〔內科一道〕
擬漢賜天下今年田租之半詔〔文帝二年〕。
擬唐以温彥博爲右僕射誥〔貞觀十年〕。
擬宋以韓琦、范仲淹爲樞密副使謝表〔慶曆三年〕。
判語〔五條〕
漏泄軍情大事。
任所置買田宅。
禁止師巫邪術。
translation_en:
…chang; in winter it is called zheng.

Thus ritual is the ruler’s great instrument of authority.

Thus feelings are manifested and righteousness is established; when the music ends, virtue is honored.

Benevolence, as a burden, is heavy; as a road, it is long. Those who lift it cannot bear its weight; those who travel it cannot reach its end. That which embraces the greatest number of things is benevolence. Is it not difficult, then, to strive to practice benevolence?

Second Session

Discourse

The sage king serves as ruler and teacher of the people.

Edicts, Pronouncements, and Memorials 〔One topic from this category [?].〕

Compose a draft edict in the voice of a Han emperor granting the people throughout the empire remission of half this year’s land tax. 〔Second year of Emperor Wen’s reign.〕

Compose a draft Tang pronouncement appointing Wen Yanbo Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs. 〔Tenth year of Zhenguan.〕

Compose a draft Song memorial of thanks for the appointment of Han Qi and Fan Zhongyan as Vice Commissioners of the Bureau of Military Affairs. 〔Third year of Qingli.〕

Legal Judgments 〔Five items.〕

Divulging important military secrets.

Purchasing fields and houses in one’s jurisdiction of office.

Prohibiting the illicit arts of ritual masters and spirit mediums.

title: 嘉靖二十二年河南鄉試錄
text:
詐教誘人犯法
失時不脩隄防
第叄塲
策〔五道〕
問自古君天下者或創業以立法或緣時
以救弊行於當時垂之久遠損益因革
雖有小異莫不著有成書以詔後世洪
惟我
太祖高皇帝立法創制高出千古
===
列聖相承重熈累洽典制疊出若夫斟酌古今
會稡無遺則具於
大明會典一書焉竊嘗伏讀
武廟御製序文而有以窺其一二矣夫
提挈綱領布列條貫
皇祖之制誠億萬年之大法也然中歲晚年間
有續定者果可得而聞歟
鴻猷聖烈政化旁行
列聖之心誠
punctuated:
詐教誘人犯法。
失時不脩隄防。

第叄塲
策〔五道〕

問：自古君天下者，或創業以立法，或緣時以救弊，行於當時，垂之久遠，損益因革，雖有小異，莫不著有成書以詔後世。洪惟我太祖高皇帝，立法創制，高出千古。列聖相承，重熈累洽，典制疊出。若夫斟酌古今，會稡無遺，則具於《大明會典》一書焉。竊嘗伏讀武廟御製序文，而有以窺其一二矣。夫提挈綱領，布列條貫，皇祖之制，誠億萬年之大法也。然中歲晚年間有續定者，果可得而聞歟？鴻猷聖烈，政化旁行，列聖之心，誠
translation_en:
Fraudulently instructing and enticing others to violate the law.
Failing to repair dikes and embankments at the proper time.

Third Session
Policy Questions〔Five questions〕

Question: Since antiquity, those who have ruled All under Heaven have either founded a dynasty and established its laws, or responded to the circumstances of their times to remedy abuses. Their measures were implemented in their own day and handed down for ages to come. Although there were minor differences in what they removed or added, retained or changed, all produced completed compilations to instruct later generations. We reverently reflect that our Emperor Taizu Gao established laws and institutions surpassing those of all previous ages. The successive sage emperors inherited his work, bringing ever greater prosperity and harmony, and issuing successive codes and institutions. As for weighing ancient and contemporary practices and assembling them without omission, this is fully accomplished in the single work, the Collected Statutes of the Great Ming (Da Ming huidian). I have humbly and reverently read the imperial preface composed by Emperor Wuzong and thereby gained some small insight into it. Setting out the guiding principles and arranging their detailed provisions, the imperial ancestor’s institutions are truly the great laws for countless ages. Yet can we learn of the further provisions established during the middle and later years? With grand plans and sagely achievements, governance and moral transformation spread far and wide. The intentions of the successive sage emperors truly…

title: 嘉靖二十二年河南鄉試錄
text:
皇祖之心也然隨時與事代各不同者亦可得
而言歟論典謨禮制而有稱其大備者
舉會要諸書而有許其尤詳者豈唐虞
而下後世制作亦有可取者歟至於開
局纂輯義必有主而類以何書附以何
事簡帙燦然有目共仰爾諸士服膺
聖訓爲日已多請明著于篇以觀
對揚之懿
問移風易俗莫善於樂故樂由中出音以
心生協之律呂感於神靈敦和飾喜未
有不由斯者是故非明於天地則禮樂
不能興焉稽之在昔虞廷之樂典以后
夔直温寬栗依永和聲不可尚已降及
三代太師掌六律六同以合陰陽之聲
至於末世尚能蹈河蹈海潔身亂邦去
古未遠彼亦聖賢之徒歟秦漢以下作
者益鮮如魏如隋如宋雖一時有志之
士往往未得其要至於神解暗解者世
punctuated:
皇祖之心也。然隨時與事，代各不同者，亦可得而言歟？論典謨禮制而有稱其大備者，舉會要諸書而有許其尤詳者，豈唐虞而下，後世制作亦有可取者歟？至於開局纂輯，義必有主，而類以何書，附以何事？簡帙燦然，有目共仰。爾諸士服膺聖訓，爲日已多，請明著于篇，以觀對揚之懿。

問：移風易俗，莫善於樂。故樂由中出，音以心生，協之律呂，感於神靈，敦和飾喜，未有不由斯者。是故非明於天地，則禮樂不能興焉。稽之在昔，虞廷之樂典，以后夔直温寬栗，依永和聲，不可尚已。降及三代，太師掌六律六同，以合陰陽之聲。至於末世，尚能蹈河蹈海，潔身亂邦，去古未遠，彼亦聖賢之徒歟？秦漢以下，作者益鮮。如魏如隋如宋，雖一時有志之士，往往未得其要。至於神解暗解者，世
translation_en:
…the intent of the Imperial Ancestor. Yet the measures that differed from reign to reign in response to particular times and circumstances—may these too be discussed? In discussing canons, counsels, and ritual institutions, some praise their great completeness; in citing the various institutional compendia, some commend their exceptional detail. Could it be that, after the ages of Tang Yao and Yu Shun, the institutions established by later generations also had merits worth adopting? As for establishing a bureau to compile the work, its organizing principles must have had a guiding purpose: by reference to which books were its categories arranged, and which matters were appended? Its volumes shine brilliantly, admired by all who behold them. You scholars have taken the Sagely Instructions to heart for many days now. Set forth your understanding clearly in writing, so that we may see the excellence of your response in extolling them.

Question: For transforming prevailing practices and changing customs, nothing surpasses music. Music therefore issues from within, and tones arise from the heart. Bringing them into accord with the pitch standards, moving divine spirits, deepening harmony, and giving graceful expression to joy—all proceed from this. Thus, without understanding Heaven and Earth, rites and music cannot flourish. Examining antiquity, we find that the musical institutions of Shun’s court, under the music master Kui, taught uprightness with gentleness and breadth of mind with firmness, with sounds following prolonged singing and the musical parts harmonizing. These could not be surpassed. Later, under the Three Dynasties, the Music Master oversaw the six yang pitch standards and the six yin pitch standards, harmonizing the sounds of yin and yang. Even in an age of decline, musicians could still depart to the Yellow River or the sea, preserving their integrity amid a disordered realm. They were not far removed from antiquity: were they too followers of the sages and worthies? From the Qin and Han onward, creators of music became ever fewer. In the Wei, Sui, and Song, although there were men of aspiration in each age, they often failed to grasp its essentials. As for those whose understanding was inspired or intuitive, in the world…

title: 嘉靖二十二年河南鄉試錄
text:
亦未嘗無其人焉其他如觀雲色而知
孟春之氣扣食器以諧絲竹之音聞磬
聲而得其月數遇乘馬而究其凶吉彼
皆何道以致然歟豈其領悟之妙魏宋
諸賢顧有所不逮歟抑小智偏長別有
一得之妙也仰惟我
朝禮樂明備奏之
郊廟奏之
朝廷情文兼盛眞有非後世能及者不知一
時領樂之官果能因其文而得其情歟
或但紀其鼓舞鏗鏘而未能言其義歟
===
茲欲推本
聖朝之樂所以追並虞廷而遠過後世者以爲
當宁之獻諸士幸相與鋪張揚厲之
問天子建德因生以賜姓胙之土而命之
氏故氏族者古史官所記也秦旣滅學
公侯子孫失其本系漢興司馬遷父子
約世本脩史記因周譜明世家而後知
punctuated:
亦未嘗無其人焉。其他如觀雲色而知孟春之氣，扣食器以諧絲竹之音，聞磬聲而得其月數，遇乘馬而究其凶吉，彼皆何道以致然歟？豈其領悟之妙，魏宋諸賢顧有所不逮歟？抑小智偏長，別有一得之妙也？仰惟我朝禮樂明備，奏之郊廟，奏之朝廷，情文兼盛，眞有非後世能及者。不知一時領樂之官，果能因其文而得其情歟？或但紀其鼓舞鏗鏘，而未能言其義歟？茲欲推本聖朝之樂所以追並虞廷而遠過後世者，以爲當宁之獻，諸士幸相與鋪張揚厲之。

問：天子建德，因生以賜姓，胙之土而命之氏。故氏族者，古史官所記也。秦旣滅學，公侯子孫失其本系。漢興，司馬遷父子約《世本》，脩《史記》，因周譜明世家，而後知
translation_en:
…there have also always been such men in the world. Other examples include discerning the vital energy of the first month of spring by observing the colors of clouds, striking eating vessels to harmonize with string and wind instruments, identifying the number of the month by hearing a stone chime, and determining good or ill fortune upon encountering a team of horses. By what means did they accomplish all this? Could their marvelous understanding have surpassed even that of the worthies of Wei and Song? Or did their limited intelligence excel in a particular field, giving them a marvelous insight of their own? We reverently consider that our dynasty’s rites and music are splendid and complete. Performed at the suburban sacrifices and ancestral temples, and performed at court, they flourish in both inner feeling and outward form, truly attaining what the later ages could not match. Yet do the officials now directing music truly apprehend its inner feeling through its outward form? Or do they merely record its drumming, dancing, and resonant sounds, without being able to explain its meaning? We now wish to investigate the foundations of our sagely dynasty’s music: how it rivals the court of Shun and far surpasses later ages. To make this an offering to His Majesty, may you gentlemen fully expound and celebrate it.

Question: The Son of Heaven established men of virtue, bestowed surnames (xing) according to their origins, and granted them lands and designated their clan names (shi). Thus, clan lineages were recorded by the ancient historiographers. After Qin destroyed learning, the descendants of dukes and marquises lost knowledge of their original lines of descent. When Han arose, Sima Qian and his father drew together material from the Origins of Hereditary Houses (Shiben) to compile the Records of the Historian (Shiji), using Zhou genealogies to elucidate the hereditary houses. Only then did people know…

title: 嘉靖二十二年河南鄉試錄
text:
姓氏之所由出今姓氏不分久矣而世
遂以氏爲姓蒙竊惑焉今試舉已往之
事請諸士相與明之昔者帝堯嘗以姓
氏賜伯禹又以賜伯夷不知其所謂
姓者何如所謂氏者又何如傳曰諸侯
以字爲氏因以爲族又曰官有世功則
有官族邑亦如之其視帝堯所賜者豈
盡合歟三代以下其事彌繁有氏於國
者有氏於謚者又有氏於官氏於爵氏
===
於居氏於事者其詳可得聞歟晉宋以
降去古雖遠譜諜猶嚴地望有所繫而
不惑姓氏有所質而無疑如過江則有
以爲僑姓者東南則有以爲吳姓者又
有爲郡姓爲虜姓者其實亦可指歟夫
人無所守則士族削士族削則國從而
衰然則氏族誠非細故也烏得以不辯
問古之君子遇則仕以行其學不遇則脩
其辭以明其道故雖入品不一識見殊
punctuated:
姓氏之所由出。今姓氏不分久矣，而世遂以氏爲姓，蒙竊惑焉。今試舉已往之事，請諸士相與明之。昔者帝堯嘗以姓氏賜伯禹，又以賜伯夷。不知其所謂姓者何如，所謂氏者又何如？傳曰：「諸侯以字爲氏，因以爲族。」又曰：「官有世功，則有官族，邑亦如之。」其視帝堯所賜者，豈盡合歟？三代以下，其事彌繁，有氏於國者，有氏於謚者，又有氏於官、氏於爵、氏於居、氏於事者，其詳可得聞歟？晉宋以降，去古雖遠，譜諜猶嚴，地望有所繫而不惑，姓氏有所質而無疑。如過江則有以爲僑姓者，東南則有以爲吳姓者，又有爲郡姓、爲虜姓者，其實亦可指歟？夫人無所守則士族削，士族削則國從而衰。然則氏族誠非細故也，烏得以不辯？

問：古之君子，遇則仕以行其學，不遇則脩其辭以明其道。故雖入品不一，識見殊
translation_en:
…the origins of ancestral surnames (xing) and lineage names (shi). For a long time now, ancestral surnames and lineage names have ceased to be distinguished, and people have consequently come to use lineage names as surnames. In my ignorance, I am privately perplexed by this. Let me now adduce events of the past and ask you gentlemen to elucidate them together. In former times, Emperor Yao bestowed an ancestral surname and a lineage name upon Bo Yu, and also bestowed them upon Bo Yi. What was meant by an ancestral surname, and what by a lineage name? The Commentary says: “The feudal lords took courtesy names as lineage names, thereby forming clans.” It also says: “When an officeholder’s family rendered meritorious service over generations, a clan bearing the name of that office was established; the same applied to fiefs.” Compared with Emperor Yao’s bestowals, did these practices correspond in every respect? From the Three Dynasties onward, such practices became increasingly varied. Some took lineage names from states, some from posthumous titles, and others from offices, noble ranks, places of residence, or occupations. May we hear the particulars?

From the Jin and Song dynasties onward, although antiquity was far distant, genealogical records remained exacting. Families’ geographical origins and standing had definite affiliations, free from confusion, and their surnames and lineage names could be verified without doubt. Thus, among those who crossed the Yangzi were families designated as émigré lineages, while in the southeast there were those designated as Wu lineages. There were also commandery lineages and non-Han lineages. Can you identify the actual families belonging to these categories? If people have no traditions to uphold, the great lineages decline; when the great lineages decline, the state weakens in their wake. Lineage and clan are therefore surely no trifling matter. How could one fail to distinguish them clearly?

Question: When gentlemen of antiquity found an opportunity, they entered office to put their learning into practice; when they found none, they cultivated their writing to illuminate their Way. Thus, although their classifications differed [?] and their understanding and insight diverged…

title: 嘉靖二十二年河南鄉試錄
text:
途要厥所至於此二端其必有合也維
茲梁豫古號多賢申呂伊尹詩書所稱
不待論矣試以唐宋數君子言之有左
右六經爲文粹然一出於正者有論決
大事粲然成文可書而誦者或廷詰北
虜以一身爲中國之重或聲色不動措
天下於太山之安或歷縣令而專尚德
化或負高識而振起斯文或三居相位
獨以寬弘範俗或三居言責皆以彈奏
===
去職或去一字而來善學之譽或攝邑
事而有明鏡之稱此數子者孰爲行道
而致身孰爲明道而立言造詣孰爲純
粹功業孰爲顯著乃吾子所願將以何
者爲法也請言之勿讓
問中州之水其大者曰黃河其次者則汴
河焉隄防疏濬世有其方揆策圖事代
不乏人昔禹之行水施功最多故歷三
代而無河患由禹故跡未嘗變也至周
punctuated:
途，要厥所至，於此二端，其必有合也。維茲梁豫，古號多賢，申、呂、伊尹，詩書所稱，不待論矣。試以唐宋數君子言之：有左右六經，爲文粹然一出於正者；有論決大事，粲然成文，可書而誦者；或廷詰北虜，以一身爲中國之重；或聲色不動，措天下於太山之安；或歷縣令而專尚德化；或負高識而振起斯文；或三居相位，獨以寬弘範俗；或三居言責，皆以彈奏去職；或去一字而來善學之譽；或攝邑事而有明鏡之稱。此數子者，孰爲行道而致身？孰爲明道而立言？造詣孰爲純粹？功業孰爲顯著？乃吾子所願，將以何者爲法也？請言之，勿讓。

問：中州之水，其大者曰黃河，其次者則汴河焉。隄防疏濬，世有其方；揆策圖事，代不乏人。昔禹之行水，施功最多，故歷三代而無河患，由禹故跡未嘗變也。至周
translation_en:
…paths, yet, taking their ultimate attainments together, they must accord with these two ends. This region of Liang and Yu has been renowned since antiquity for its many worthies. Shen, Lü, and Yi Yin, celebrated in the Classic of Poetry and the Classic of Documents, need no discussion here. Let us instead consider several gentlemen of the Tang and Song. One supported the Six Classics through writings that issued purely and entirely from what was correct. Another deliberated upon and settled great affairs in words so lucidly composed that they could be recorded and recited. One challenged the northern barbarians at court, his person alone lending weight to China. Another, without changing his voice or expression, brought the realm to a security as firm as Mount Tai. One served successive terms as district magistrate, giving priority exclusively to moral transformation. Another possessed lofty discernment and revived this cultural tradition. One occupied the position of chief councilor three times, setting an example for prevailing customs through magnanimity alone. Another held remonstrance responsibilities three times and on each occasion lost office because of his impeachment memorials. One removed a single character and thereby earned praise for knowing how to learn. Another administered a district in an acting capacity and earned the appellation “bright mirror.” Of these gentlemen, which devoted themselves to service in order to put the Way into practice? Which established teachings in words in order to illuminate the Way? Whose attainments were purest? Whose achievements were most distinguished? Given your own aspirations, which will you take as your model? Please explain without holding back.

Question: Of the waterways of the Central Region, the greatest is the Huang He, and next comes the Bian He. Every age has had its methods for embankment construction and dredging; no era has lacked men to assess strategies and plan works. In antiquity, Yu accomplished the most in guiding the waters. Thus, throughout the Three Dynasties there were no calamities from the Huang He, because the channels established by Yu had never been altered. By the Zhou…

title: 嘉靖二十二年河南鄉試錄
text:
定王之時禹跡一改而河失故道患由
此多議因以起有欲索故跡而穿之者
有欲出之胡中者有以爲天事可勿理
者有以爲宜空水衝以縱其決穿漕渠
以通其勢者有以爲宜弛灌漑之防使
水得自行者有以爲計隄防又以爲隄
防非義者可歷指其人歟汴水自禹於
滎澤分大河爲陰溝出之淮泗至於浚
儀渠分爲二或疏之以灌魏郡或自五
===
池以注鴻溝或循河故瀆以入浚儀或
累石爲門以遏渠口或欲通之而不果
或更疏鑿以漕運又有建議大發丁夫
起滎澤而達江淮千有餘里者亦有用
淮南租船泝鴻溝而輸河陰運米七百
萬石者可歷詳其事歟夫決堤蕩畝損
人耗財黃河之害誠不可有至於鍾美
出惡以漕以灌汴河之利似亦不可無
者今欲去無已之害以興自然之利以
punctuated: 定王之時，禹跡一改，而河失故道，患由此多，議因以起。有欲索故跡而穿之者，有欲出之胡中者，有以爲天事可勿理者，有以爲宜空水衝以縱其決、穿漕渠以通其勢者，有以爲宜弛灌漑之防、使水得自行者，有以爲計隄防、又以爲隄防非義者，可歷指其人歟？汴水自禹於滎澤分大河爲陰溝，出之淮泗，至於浚儀，渠分爲二。或疏之以灌魏郡，或自五池以注鴻溝，或循河故瀆以入浚儀，或累石爲門以遏渠口，或欲通之而不果，或更疏鑿以漕運，又有建議大發丁夫，起滎澤而達江淮千有餘里者，亦有用淮南租船泝鴻溝而輸河陰、運米七百萬石者，可歷詳其事歟？夫決堤蕩畝，損人耗財，黃河之害誠不可有。至於鍾美出惡，以漕以灌，汴河之利似亦不可無者。今欲去無已之害，以興自然之利，以
translation_en:
…in the time of King Ding of Zhou, once Yu’s watercourses were altered, the river lost its former course. Disasters consequently multiplied, and proposals arose in response. Some wished to seek out the old course and excavate it; some wished to divert the river into the lands of the Hu; some considered it Heaven’s affair and thought it could be left unattended. Some thought that land in the path of the current should be vacated to allow floodwaters to escape, and transport canals excavated to give the flow an outlet. Some thought that the barriers used for irrigation should be opened, allowing the water to follow its own course. Some proposed planning embankments, while others held that embankments were contrary to what was right. Can you identify each of these men in turn?

As for the Bian River, Yu divided off the Yellow River at Xingze to form the Yingou channel and led its waters into the Huai and Si rivers; at Junyi, the channel divided into two. Some dredged it to irrigate Wei Commandery; some directed water from Wuchi into the Honggou; some followed the Yellow River’s old channel into Junyi; some piled up stones to make a gate blocking the channel’s mouth; some wished to open it but failed to do so; and some dredged and excavated it anew for grain transport. There were also those who proposed a massive levy of laborers to undertake work extending from Xingze to the Yangzi and Huai rivers, a distance of more than a thousand li. Others used boats carrying tax grain from Huainan to travel upstream along the Honggou and deliver seven million shi of rice to Heyin. Can you explain each of these undertakings in detail?

Breaching embankments and sweeping away fields, harming people and consuming resources—the damage caused by the Yellow River must certainly be prevented. Yet in gathering beneficial waters and discharging harmful ones, and in providing transport and irrigation, the benefits of the Bian River likewise seem indispensable. Now, if we wish to eliminate unceasing harm and bring forth the benefits offered by nature, among the foregoing…
